nodes.title: Configuration K09-L
nodes.text: Quad tailsitter: rectangular flying wing, reflexed section, two fins at +/-0.32 m each on a vertical CF tube through the wing with a motor at each tube end (4 motors in X), stands on the fin tips, two elevons, airspeed sensor; no pusher, no tilt, no structural field joint

nodes.title: Mass gate 2.6 kg
nodes.text: As-built take-off mass with pack <= 2.6 kg (H1 GT-06, guard-banded by CL-H1-WEIGH-ACCEPT); the allocations in params.json#mass.allocation_g (D-48) plus the 245 g A1 reserve equal the gate, and the reserve covers A3's growth by maturity plus the 0.1 kg first-build overrun; every subsystem reports against its allocation

nodes.title: Hover thrust-to-weight
nodes.text: Hover T/W >= 2.0 at the 2.6 kg gate at full throttle with the 100 A limiter on a fresh pack; >= 1.6 in the worst pack state (20 % charge, 10 degC); measured on the thrust stand

nodes.title: Stall speed
nodes.text: Stall speed at the 2.6 kg gate <= 12 m/s

nodes.title: Transition speed
nodes.text: Forward transition completes at >= 1.3 x stall speed; cruise speed is at or above that

nodes.title: Mission endurance
nodes.text: Hover >= 2 min total plus cruise >= 5 min on one pack with 20 % energy reserve, no payload

nodes.title: Wind
nodes.text: Hover and fin-tip landing controllable in 5 m/s steady wind; 8 m/s gust is survive-and-land

nodes.title: Stance tip-over
nodes.text: Static tip-over angle toward the pod side (about the narrow axis of the four-foot stance, pad contact at z +/-0.218 m with the feet splayed, z_cg subtracted) >= 30 deg at the worst flying CG (forward end of cg.x_range_m, top of cg.z_range_m, any pack from 503 to 680 g); landings are flown with a wingtip into the wind (flight card, C5 stance rules S1-S8), so the angle needed on that axis is the span-into-wind case, not the broadside one

nodes.title: Prop clearance
nodes.text: Geometric gap between any prop tip and structure or another prop >= 25 mm (PROPOSED; B4/D3 re-derive)

nodes.title: Elevon area
nodes.text: Total elevon area 15-25 % of wing area, frozen on the foam-board twin's result (PROPOSED)

nodes.title: Static margin
nodes.text: Static margin in cruise >= 5 % chord with elevons neutral, CG inside the range B3 sets (PROPOSED value)

nodes.title: Budget $2 000
nodes.text: Total spend <= $2 000 incl. tax, shipping, packs, charger, radio, test gear, spares, box

nodes.title: Crash reserve
nodes.text: Reserve at order time on pessimistic numbers >= one bad crash ($309 incl. tax); planned reserve >= $150

nodes.title: One-piece transport
nodes.text: Aircraft travels in one piece in one foam-lined box no larger than requirements.box_external_m (1.25 x 0.55 x 0.54 m at D-31; 0.50 at D-16, 0.45 at P9), <= 6 kg loaded without the flight packs (LiPo bag); field-ready in <= 5 min by one person with no tool other than the 10 mm prop spanner in the pouch (D-40)

nodes.title: Connectors carry the current
nodes.text: Every power connector and the main disconnect (AS150U, D-32) are rated >= 1.25 x the continuous design current, defined as the largest of the hover, cruise and vertical-climb currents on E2's pessimistic profile at 30 degC (CL-F1-I-CONT), and carry the <= 60 s case and the <= 5 s momentary case (120 A unlimited; 100 A with the limiter, 105 A with a 5 % sensor under-read) inside a cited rating; aircraft-side wiring: steady temperature rise <= 10 degC at the continuous design current (electrical.wire_temp_rise_max_c) and <= 30 degC for any case shorter than 60 s (electrical.wire_temp_rise_short_max_c; conductor <= 60 degC, 14 K under the XPS limit); the pack's own leads (>= 10 AWG after re-termination): steady rise <= 20 degC (electrical.pack_lead_rise_max_c; conductor <= 50 degC, cell tabs under the 60 degC LiPo limit)

nodes.title: Build hours
nodes.text: <= 90 team-hours to first hover and <= 3 weeks from first cut

nodes.title: Stable autopilot build
nodes.text: Flight controller runs a stable (not beta) ArduPilot Plane build with tailsitter support, logging to SD or flash

nodes.title: Thermal limits
nodes.text: Motors, ESCs, pack and avionics stay within rating for the full mission; the field-ambient ceiling is reported
